changelog: FIX (4 distinct crashes on weak Fire Sticks): Channel-zap on Fire Stick Lite no longer crashes when categories change mid-playback. Sports game picker no longer crashes when you tap quickly. Search no longer crashes with very long playlist titles. Low-RAM devices (1 GB Fire Stick Lite / 1080p models) get a smaller image cache so the app can't run out of memory loading Movies / Series posters.
FIX: Upgraded Jetpack Compose to 1.7.6 to pick up Google's fix for the LazyLayout double-release crash that fired when navigating in/out of detail screens.
FIX (v515): 'Switch to Lite Mode' in Settings now takes effect instantly.
FIX (v514): Permanent Fire Stick ANR fix — Moshi JSON adapters compile-time generated.
FIX (v513): Throttled the license-check loop back to 30 s.
FIX (v510): Resolved Google Play Protect 'harmful app' warning.
FIX (v509): Player on-screen options menu D-pad selection.
FIX (v506): Discovery hero TMDB backdrop fallback.
FIX (v504): Parental Controls hide locked categories everywhere.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
